title: Writing one in Rust

Build a cdylib for wasm32-unknown-unknown that exports memory, sitefile_alloc and sitefile_transform. The request and result are JSON. This site's badge plugin is about two hundred lines of standard-library Rust, including its own tiny JSON parser, so it needs no crates at all and builds offline. Any language that targets WebAssembly without imports can do the same: C with clang, Zig, AssemblyScript or hand-written WAT.
